map.退保金（现金价值）估算 使用指南: Surrender value (cash value) estimation user guide
map.退保金（现金价值）估算器。输入已交保费、年限与退保参数，估算保单现金价值与退保金: Surrender value (cash value) estimator. Input premiums paid, years and surrender parameters to estimate policy cash value and surrender amount, for life-insurance surrender gain/loss reference (follow the contract).
map.现金价值 = 准备金 × 退保比例: Cash value = reserve x surrender ratio
map.早期退保看能拿回多少现金价值，避免损失预期错配。: Early surrender sees how much cash value can be recovered, avoiding mismatched loss expectations.
map.对比不同退保比例假设下的到手金额。: Compare the amount received under different surrender-ratio assumptions.
map.：现金价值 = 50000×0.8 = 40000 元。即退保约拿回 4 万（早: : cash value = 50000 x 0.8 = 40000 yuan. That is, surrender recovers about 40,000 (low early ratio is normal).
map.由索赔频率与平均赔付额求期望损失: Expected loss from claim frequency and average payout
map.由一年生存概率求死亡力: Find force of mortality from one-year survival probability
map.由纯保费与附加费率求毛保费: Gross premium from pure premium and loading rate
map.退保比例为啥早期低？: Why is the surrender ratio low early?
map.前期费用摊销重、死差费差未积累，现金价值低；持有越久比例越接近准备金。: Heavy early-expense amortization and unaccumulated mortality/expense margins make cash value low; the longer held, the closer the ratio approaches the reserve.
map.现金价值和已交保费为什么差很多？: Why do cash value and premiums paid differ so much?
map.早期现金价值远低于已交保费，因为要摊回初始费用（佣金、核保、单证）并扣除退保前的: Early cash value is far below premiums paid, because initial expenses (commission, underwriting, documents) must be amortized back and pre-surrender risk cost deducted; this is the regulator-allowed expense allocation method.
